190452.overview: In Ultraman Monster Battle, the player controls Ultraman (or a variant) in combat against monsters in a one-on-one battle. The player issues attack commands (punches, special attacks) and dodges or blocks monster actions. Health or energy bars track remaining vitality, and successive phases or monster types present escalating challenge. The objective is to defeat the monster before Ultraman's health runs out.

190468.overview: Your mission is to blast the aliens out of the sky while avoiding their attacking bombs, to score the maximum points possible of 999.

422765.overview: Double sided type game, submarine's vs. destroyers. One player is the destroyer, the other is the submarine, and you try to blow each other up! When playing single player, you can choose if you want to be the destroyer or the sub, and the computer plays the other.
